basic_details.offering_entity: Saudi Ministry of Education & Qassim University (Buraydah, Al-Qassim Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Qassim University Main Campus (Buraydah, Al-Qassim Province, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all academic divisions with prominent programs in College of Computer (Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering), College of Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil), College of Science, College of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine, and College of Business and Economics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 300 to 450 fully funded international student scholarships awarded annually across all colleges
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Government bilateral country quota: 35 dedicated seats allocated annually for Pakistani citizens
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor degree (including foundation year); 2 years for Master; 3 years for PhD, subject to satisfactory academic performance

nationality_requirements: Non-Saudi international citizens residing outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate candidates must be between 17 and 25 years of age; postgraduate candidates must be under 35 years of age at application time.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate Pre-Engineering or ICS) with minimum 75% marks (or 'Very Good' / Grade B+) for Bachelor's; completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA for Master's.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade of 'Very Good' (Jayyid Jiddan) on secondary school credentials.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering, Computer Science, or Mathematics background for College of Computer and College of Engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Must have graduated within the past 5 years from date of application.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Secondary school graduation certificate must not be older than 5 years at application time.

english_proficiency.notes: College of Computer conducts all instruction in English (ABET-accredited); English Medium of Instruction certificates from Pakistani institutions accepted.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Zero Arabic language requirement for College of Computer and College of Engineering. Free introductory Arabic classes provided for daily living.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female students must have an eligible Mahram (male guardian) in Saudi Arabia or meet current Saudi university international student housing criteria.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: International students applying under the Saudi Ministry of Education bilateral country quota.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot have previously held another scholarship from a Saudi educational institution.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition exemption for all semesters of normal degree duration.

admission_application_fee.details: Application via the official Study in Saudi portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished single/double dormitory room in Qassim University International Student Housing, with all utilities, air conditioning, and Wi-Fi included.
accommodation.amount: Free university housing (~SAR 10,000 / year value; ~PKR 760,000 / yr)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid by Saudi Government: SAR 840/month for Undergraduate students (~PKR 64,000/mo); SAR 1,000/month for Master's and PhD students (~PKR 76,000/mo).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy class flight ticket provided between Pakistan and Qassim/Riyadh, plus initial arrival ticket.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Student Visa and residence permit (Iqama) issued free of charge through the Saudi Embassy in Pakistan.

health_insurance.details: Free comprehensive medical and dental treatment at Qassim University Medical City and public hospitals.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized dining halls on campus serve nutritious meals at nominal prices (~SAR 3 to 5/meal; ~PKR 220 to 380/meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual book allowance (equivalent to one month stipend) and thesis printing grant upon completion.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Deanship of Scientific Research funds laboratory consumables and conference attendance for research students.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttle bus service connecting campus dormitories, sports facilities, library, and academic colleges.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single major comprehensive university: Qassim University (Buraydah, Al-Qassim Province, Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 800 global university (QS World #701-710, top 20 in Arab World). Computing programs ABET-accredited; recognized center for agriculture, engineering, and computer science.
available_majors: College of Computer: Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering
College of Engineering: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering
College of Science: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry
College of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine: Plant Production, Animal Production, Food Science
College of Business and Economics: Finance, Accounting, Business Administration
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Undergraduate: 4 to 5 years (including foundation year); Master: 2 years; PhD: 3 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Secondary school certificate with 75%+ marks, age 17-25 (undergrad) or under 35 (grad), medical clearance, police character certificate, and attested credentials.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Computer and College of Engineering are most popular; College of Science and College of Agriculture have high acceptance probability.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply via the unified 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa) during the September-November window. Ensure all intermediate and matric documents are attested by IBCC and MOFA Pakistan before uploading.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Saudi Government Unified 'Study in Saudi' (Minhati) Portal & Qassim University Admissions
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the Saudi Ministry of Education unified portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa), select Qassim University, choose major, and submit application.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (July - August): Attest Matric and Intermediate certificates/degrees from IBCC and MOFA Pakistan; obtain Police Character Certificate and Medical Fitness Report.
Step 2 (September - November): Register on the 'Study in Saudi' unified portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa); select Qassim University as preferred institution.
Step 3 (November): Upload all required documents (with Arabic translations) and submit application.
Step 4 (December - February): Qassim University Deanship of Admissions reviews files, verifies eligibility, and ranks applicants.
Step 5 (March - April): Recommended candidates forwarded to Saudi Ministry of Education for government quota allocation and security review.
Step 6 (May - June): Final admission and scholarship notifications issued; electronic visa approval numbers dispatched.
Step 7 (July - August): Student visa stamped at Saudi Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi; e-ticket provided by university.
Step 8 (Late August / Early September): Arrival at Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport (Qassim); university shuttle takes scholars to campus dormitories.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated government application: Admission automatically carries full government scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters from former teachers or community leaders uploaded online.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation Statement (Arabic or English): Detail academic background, goals, and reasons for studying at Qassim University.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduate applicants. For Master's/PhD: 2 page study plan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Brief academic CV listing education, grades, and extracurriculars.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None required for international external applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Saudi Embassy authentication upon selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified Arabic translation for all English/Urdu documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the unified Study in Saudi portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport info page valid for at least two years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure Pakistani machine-readable passport is scanned in color.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Secondary School Certificate & Detailed Mark Sheet
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official matriculation and intermediate (HSSC) certificates and mark sheets.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC and MOFA Pakistan, with certified Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive medical fitness certificate from GAMCA-approved center certifying freedom from infectious diseases.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained from GAMCA / GCC approved center in Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Police Character Certificate certifying clean criminal record.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Recommendation letters from former teachers or professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed letters highlighting academic capability and character.
Nadra Birth Certificate attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual application intake cycle running for Fall semester enrollment.

selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Referee appraisals of character and academic aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Qassim University International Admissions Committee & Saudi Ministry of Education.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Bilateral quota ranking: Applicants are ranked by academic percentage within country quota allocations (35 seats for Pakistan). Shortlisted candidates undergo ministry background check and final approval by Saudi Ministry of Education.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~5,000 to 8,000 international applicants across all participating countries
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~25.0% (Dedicated bilateral quota of ~35 seats gives strong odds to well-qualified Pakistani applicants)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 80%+ in Pakistani Intermediate (HSSC / Pre-Engineering / ICS) or 3.25+ CGPA for Master's
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Strong academic record, clean disciplinary and medical history, complete Arabic-translated and attested document dossier.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from across Pakistan with Intermediate certificates from recognized BISE boards.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Yemen

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized commercial recruiters claiming to sell Qassim University scholarships. Saudi government scholarships are 100% free and strictly processed via the official Study in Saudi portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Qassim University scholarship has zero application fees. Never pay fees to private parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Apply independently; agents have zero influence over Ministry of Education selection.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Document attestation and Arabic translation fees (~PKR 25,000 - 40,000).
Initial settling cash before first stipend disbursement (~SAR 500; ~PKR 38,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Computer Science is taught in Arabic. (FACT: Coursework in the College of Computer is 100% in English).
CLAIM: IELTS is mandatory. (FACT: English Medium of Instruction certificates are accepted).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some blogs claim scholarships can be deferred; official regulations require enrolling in the admitted semester or forfeiting the seat.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA of 2.75 / 5.00 each semester; lower GPA triggers academic warning and stipend review.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory regular attendance in all lectures; absence exceeding 20% results in course failure.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester academic performance reviews reported to the Deanship of Admissions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Students on scholarship visa (Iqama) are strictly prohibited from taking outside commercial employment in the Kingdom.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars must depart the Kingdom upon completion of their degree program within the period specified by Saudi regulations (typically 3 months post-graduation).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or repayment requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminates upon academic dismissal or disciplinary violation; past disbursements are not reclaimed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another university within Saudi Arabia is strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing majors is permitted only within the same college during the first year subject to dean approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the standard program duration; maximum one semester extension allowed with Ministry approval.
